family.description: This domain is found in fungal proteins, including copper acquisition factor BIM1 from Cryptococcus neoformans, a cell-surface bound protein that functions in the copper-accumulation pathway shared by the CUF1-dependent copper transporter CTR1 [[cite:PUB00101283],[cite:PUB00101282]]. BIM1 facilitates copper acquisition in the brain of mammalian hosts and acts as a copper-dependent virulence trait in fungal meningitis [[cite:PUB00101283]]. This domain has a lytic polysaccharide monooxygenase-like (LPMO, [pfam:PF03067]) fold, which are evolutionarily related but have diverged to a different biological function.
family.name: Copper acquisition factor BIM1-like
